title: docs(spec): state what `fieldGroups[].collapsed` maps to on its own
body:
Part of #19311

Clause-②: no

Why that reading: one `.describe()` string on an already-deprecated alias. No key is added, removed or re-typed, no accept set moves, the normalizer is untouched, and the public export set is byte-identical. The grade stays `patch` exactly as measured below.

## What the card asked, and what re-measuring found

#19311 is a verification request: its own body says the reading is INHERITED, was not seat-verified, and asks whether it still holds on today's `origin/main` with a lit control. Both halves were re-measured here rather than inherited.

### Half 1 — the spec side

Instrument: `git grep -nE` over `packages/spec/src/**/*.zod.ts`, plus `ObjectSchema.safeParse` run against the package built from this branch. Radius: this repository at `eea7ccc3ec` (the branch point) for the greps; the built `packages/spec/dist` for the parse. Dark control: a nonsense token of the same shape (`collapsibul`) over the same glob returns 0 hits, so the instrument discriminates.

The describes **do** already name `collapsible`, and both keys are deprecated in favour of the ADR-0085 `collapse` enum — so the card's literal claim ("the describe does not mention `collapsible`") is stale. What is **not** stale is the gap underneath it: nothing in the published text says what `collapsed` maps to **on its own**. Measured, nine inputs on one field group:

| authored on the group | `collapse` after parse |
| :--- | :--- |
| `collapsed: true` | `'collapsed'` |
| `collapsed: false` | `'none'` |
| `collapsible: true` | `'expanded'` |
| `collapsible: false` | `'none'` |
| `collapsed: true` + `collapsible: false` | `'collapsed'` — `collapsed` outranks |
| `collapsed: true` + `collapsible: true` | `'collapsed'` |
| `defaultExpanded: false` | `'collapsed'` |
| neither key (lit control) | `'none'` |
| an explicit `collapse` (lit control) | wins; the aliases are not read |

The last two rows are the run's own controls: the default arm fires when nothing is authored, and the alias arm is skipped when `collapse` is present — so the other seven rows are the normalizer's doing and not an artefact.

`collapse: 'collapsed'` is described one screen above as *collapsible, starts closed*. So on this surface `collapsed: true` alone already implies collapsible — the behaviour was never the gap; the **text** was. The mapping lives only in the docblock of a non-exported helper, which nothing publishes, while the sibling alias `defaultExpanded` spelled its own mapping out in its describe and these two did not.

### Half 2 — the consumer side

Two radii, measured separately.

**This repository.** `git grep -nE "\.collapsed\b|\.collapsible\b"` over `packages/*/src/**`, excluding `packages/spec/src`, tests and generated files → **0 hits**. Lit control on the same instrument and the same glob: `\.visibleWhen\b` returns hits in five or more files. Nothing here reads the raw pair; rendering is the sibling repo's.

**The pinned sibling.** Read at `.objectui-sha` = `87af769e9a3ee28ace099fdd653d3ebd79fe82e2`, which `git merge-base --is-ancestor` confirms (exit 0, self-proving) is an ancestor of the objectui checkout on this box. Dark control on a nonsense token of the same shape over the same blob: 0 hits.

- `packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx:1560` — `const isCollapsible = Boolean(section.collapsible) || Boolean(section.collapsed);` — the maintainer ruling of 2026-09-18 (letter A: `collapsed` implies `collapsible`, read from the declaration) is **applied**, and the pin carries it.
- `packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx:609` and `:677` — both arms pass `collapsible: section.collapsible` alone. The file names objectui#9780 in a comment and declares the residual deliberately fenced.

So the downstream half is **partly repaired and partly still open**, and the open part is another repo's and another seat's. Nothing about it is touched here.

## The change

One describe, on the declared file surface and nothing else:

```text
before:  [DEPRECATED → collapse] Boolean pair with `collapsible`; use the `collapse` enum.
after:   [DEPRECATED → collapse] true → 'collapsed' (collapsible, starts closed) on its own — it
         needs no `collapsible` and outranks `collapsible: false`; false → 'none', or 'expanded'
         beside `collapsible: true`. Use the `collapse` enum.
```

`content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` is regenerated from it by the repo's own generator, never by hand.

### Reverse verification — the gate can see this text

Run in order on this branch, exit codes captured before any pipe:

1. after the edit and a spec rebuild, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:docs` → **exit 1**, naming `content/docs/references/data/object.mdx` as out of date. That is the lit control: the gate reads this describe.
2. `gen:schema && gen:docs` → the two published rows change and nothing else does (the shape is nested under two parents, hence two identical row edits).
3. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` → **exit 0**, all 15 generated artifacts up to date.

Step 1 is what makes step 3 a measurement rather than a silence.

## Verification

Measured at `1fae1ecc40`, the last commit on this branch.

| run | exit |
| :--- | :--- |
| the 101 commands from `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` | 0 — each captured before any pipe; six first returned **3** (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, never read as a pass), were cleared by building `@objectstack/lint...`, `@objectstack/client-react`, `@objectstack/objectql` and then the whole workspace, and re-ran at 0 |
| `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` reconciliation | 0 — 101 derived families accounted for, 101 run, 0 not-measured |
| the six roster families whose roster sits under a directory this diff touches | 0 each — run explicitly rather than read as silent |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` | 0 — 514 files, 14991 passed, 1 todo |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` | 0 — includes `check:test-typecheck`; `tsc --listFiles` shows the main program carries 0 `*.test.ts`, which is why that second gate is the one covering them |
| `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated` | 0 |
| `pnpm lint` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, whole repo, not narrowed) | 0 — 1m46s |

## Changeset — measured, not pattern-matched

`patch` on `@objectstack/spec`. Decided by grepping the new describe text through each entry of this package's own `files[]` after a real build:

- **positive** — the new text is present in 20 files under `dist`, 11 under `json-schema`, and in `src/data/object.zod.ts`, which `files[]` ships verbatim as `src/**/*.zod.ts`. It publishes three ways over.
- **negative, with a lit leg** — the same grep finds `are GENERATED — do not hand-edit them` in `packages/spec/scripts/lib/generated-output.ts` and in **0** files across every `files[]` path. So the instrument separates shipped from unshipped, and the positive above is not an artefact of grepping everything.

`skip-changeset` would therefore be wrong here.

## Hand-written docs corpus — key-name probe

The Docs Drift Check bot listed nothing on this head and says in its own words that an empty list is **not a clean bill of health**: an emitter-only diff shares no identifier with a page that states the rule by its inputs. So the probe was dropped from the sentence to the narrowest token any page restating this rule must still carry.

Radius: the whole hand-written `content/docs` corpus — 216 tracked files, generated `content/docs/references/**` excluded by pathspec. Instrument: `git grep -nw` per token.

| token | hit lines |
| :--- | :--- |
| `collapsed` | 17 |
| `collapsible` | 16 |
| `collapse` | 24 |
| `fieldGroups` | 21 |
| **unique lines, deduplicated** | **72, across 31 pages** |
| dark control `collapsable` (near-miss spelling) | 0 — exit 1 |
| lit control `defaultExpanded` | 1 — exit 0 |

Not a double zero, so the instrument discriminates.

**Reading: nothing is falsified.** No hand-written page states the `fieldGroups[].collapsible` / `collapsed` mapping at all, so none of them can contradict a describe that now states it. The one page that documents the enum — `content/docs/data-modeling/schema-design.mdx:316` — already spells `'collapsed'` as *collapsible and starts closed*, which is exactly what the corrected describe now says. It names only `defaultExpanded` as the deprecated alias and omits this pair: an omission, not a contradiction, and not edited here. Every single-hit page (18 of them) uses "collapse" in the ordinary English sense of folding two things into one, not as a metadata key.

`content/docs/releases/**` contributed 14 of the 72 lines across five pages. Release-owned and read-only: none of them states the mapping rule, all are feature-note prose, and none was touched.

**Three hits are about the OTHER surface** — the form-view `sections[]` pair (`FormSectionSchema`, `packages/spec/src/ui/view.zod.ts`), which this PR does not touch and which has no alias mapping behind it. They are reported, not edited, and routing them is the dispatching seat's:

- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/concept.mdx:588-596` — a YAML example captioned *"Advanced section (collapsed by default)"* that authors `collapsed: true` on a form section with **no** `collapsible` beside it. At the pinned `.objectui-sha`, the two `DrawerForm` arms honour that literally.
- `content/docs/ui/views.mdx:416-417` — the section key table reads `collapsible` = "Can section be collapsed", `collapsed` = "Initially collapsed", silent about the dependency the 2026-09-18 ruling settled.
- `content/docs/protocol/objectui/layout-dsl.mdx:354-355`, `:422`, `:529`, `:835-836` — the same pair documented four more times without the dependency. The authored example at `:354-355` writes both keys together, so it is safe as written.

**Limit of this radius, stated:** the probe sees a page that NAMES one of the four tokens. It does **not** see a page that describes collapse behaviour in prose with no key name at all. Nothing here claims more than the token can carry.

## Acceptance notes

Noted, deliberately not ridden along:

- **`collapsible`'s describe carries the mirror-image silence.** `collapsible: true` alone parses to `collapse: 'expanded'` and its describe says only `` Boolean pair with `collapsed` ``. Same family, same correction shape; left out because the card names `collapsed` and the dispatch said the describe and nothing else.
- **The `@deprecated` TSDoc lines above both keys** still read "pair with X", the framing that produced the card. They are IDE text, not published-page text, so they are a separate, smaller surface.

A measured finding on a file outside this PR's declared surface is reported to the dispatching seat rather than filed from here.
